This paragraph is ordinary prose in one language, but the value below
belongs to a different locale and is vouched for by that locale's own
keyword. The point is that a locale-scoped pattern still fires in an
otherwise foreign document: language is a soft boost signal, not a gate.

The Munich branch confirmed the shipment. Its Postleitzahl 10115
identifies the delivery district for the courier.

The remaining sentences are plain prose with no other sensitive values,
so nothing else here should be detected or redacted.
